name: wook8170-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by Wook Jang: a process harness, an agent workbench (Lanekeeper), a production-readiness audit, and a set of everyday skills.

plugins.name: king-wjang-harness
plugins.description: Hook and CLI harness that enforces design → build → ship process discipline. Completely silent in projects without a .harness/ directory.

plugins.name: lanekeeper
plugins.description: Workbench for running parallel Claude Code agent lanes: model routing, lane and slot limits, git safety guards, handoff and review. Claude Code only (ships bin/ tools).

plugins.name: verifying-production-readiness
plugins.description: Audit skill for go/no-go release decisions. It bases the verdict on observed evidence across eleven axes and checks the defect ledger with a lint script, so the verdict cannot claim more than the evidence shows.

plugins.name: wook-skills
plugins.description: Ten everyday Claude Code skills: session handoff and pickup, work status, code structure limits, readable Korean writing, design deliverables, PDF typesetting, glossary checks, 2x retina capture, and a UI stability harness. Project-specific values come from .claude/skills-config/<skill>.md.
